caption: Figure 4: TANGO is a hybrid control and data-plane approach to performant routing over the public Internet, informed by fine-grained, trustworthy telemetry. TANGO relies on cooperation: both edge networks share secret keys and per-class performance objectives.
subject: the life cycle of one packet through TANGO's monitor, reroute, and control-plane modules from sender to receiver

groups.why_chosen: One packet's metrics and, when needed, one signed route update both travel the same round trip across the public Internet, verified at every hop before any route table is trusted enough to change.
